Four samples of the pipeline on Opus 5.5 in independent and blind mode and three in seeded mode, over all 24 evaluation papers (claims within tolerance of the paper's printed value).  *Sample 1* is the model-matched row used everywhere else in this report: the API run (`claude-opus-5-5`) for Grier, Leeson, Manekin and Montero and the first oracle run for the other twenty.  *Sample 2* is a second oracle run (label `desktop-opus-run2`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-13papers-all-modes-2026-10-23.json` for the 13 earlier papers, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-4papers-all-modes-2026-11-02.json` for the four of ROADMAP 3.6, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-6papers-all-modes-2026-11-02.json` for the six of ROADMAP 3.7, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-1paper-all-modes-2026-11-06.json` for the R7 paper of ROADMAP 3.9), so for the four API papers the samples differ in route as well as draw.  *Sample 3* is a third oracle run on the frozen pipeline (label `desktop-opus-run3`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run3-23papers-all-modes-2026-11-03.json` for the 23 earlier papers, ROADMAP 3.7.4; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run3-1paper-all-modes-2026-11-06.json` for the R7 paper, ROADMAP 3.9).  *Sample 4* is a fourth oracle run on the frozen pipeline in independent and blind mode only (label `desktop-opus-run4`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run4-24papers-indep-blind-2026-11-08.json`, ROADMAP 3.10); seeded mode has none, so the all-modes rows leave it out.  The agent column is its first sample.  The columns marked (1, 2) compare pipeline samples 1 and 2 cell by cell (paper × mode); *cells identical (1, 2, 3)* counts the cells with the same final count in samples 1 to 3 and *max spread (1, 2, 3)* is the largest difference between a cell's highest and lowest of those three; the *all samples* columns do the same over every sample of the cell (four in independent and blind mode, three in seeded).
